description: The same rule as `a-field-title-spelled-plain`, on the third formatter. `functionalTitleFormatter` spells the derivation as a call rather than as prose: `const fn = aggregate || timeUnitParams?.unit || (timeUnitParams?.maxbins && 'timeunit') || (isBinning(bin) && 'bin'); return fn ? `${fn.toUpperCase()}(${field})` : field;`. So a mean is `MEAN(v)`, a bucketed month `MONTH(t)`, a bin `BIN(v)`, and a column with nothing done to it keeps its own name. The two extremes come first and keep their words, spelled as the call: `v for argmax(c)`, where the verbal formatter writes `v for max c`. The last panel is upstream's own oddity, reproduced rather than tidied: a **count** has no field and nothing guards it, so the title is literally `COUNT(undefined)` — a caption nobody would choose, and the one a chart asking for `functional` is given.
